modifications: Upstream source is unchanged. A separate denyexec preload library and deployment launcher restrict startup and runtime access.
configuration: A PulseAudio null sink provides audio output. Media lives under DATA_DIR/workspace and native settings under DATA_DIR/config/cmus. The launcher fixes the output configuration and validates saved startup settings; denyexec applies seccomp and Landlock. The application exposes its native Unix control socket.

notes.build: Compiled on Ubuntu 24.04 with PulseAudio and AO enabled; CDIO, CDDB, DISCID, MPRIS, JACK, OSS and SNDIO disabled. See solve.sh.
notes.corresponding_source: The unmodified GPL source archive is retained alongside the task.
